Class SpaceObject

java.lang.Object
SpaceObject
Direct Known Subclasses:
DensityAnalysis
public class SpaceObject extends Object
The SpaceObject class represents a general object in space, such as debris, satellites, rocket bodies, or unknown objects. It encapsulates key properties related to identification, origin, orbital characteristics, and age for use in a space object tracking system.

This class also provides functionality to initialize its fields dynamically from a CSV data row by mapping column headers to object attributes.

CSV Column Mapping Assumption:

  • recordID → "norad_cat_id"
  • satelliteName → "satellite_name"
  • country → "country"
  • orbitType → "approximate_orbit_type"
  • objectType → "object_type"
  • launchYear → "launch_year"
  • launchSite → "launch_site"
  • longitude → "longitude"
  • avgLongitude → "avg_longitude"
  • geohash → "geohash"
  • daysOld → "days_old"
  • conjunctionCount → "conjunction_count"

  • Method Details

    • loadFromRow

      public void loadFromRow(String[] row, String inputFilePath)
      Loads the space object's attributes from a given row of CSV data and the header row of a file. Dynamically assigns the values to corresponding fields by matching column headers.

      Expected row values (in any order) must include:

       "norad_cat_id", "satellite_name", "country", "approximate_orbit_type", "object_type",
 "launch_year", "launch_site", "longitude", "avg_longitude", "geohash", "days_old", "conjunction_count"
      Parameters:
      row - An array of string values representing one CSV line of space object data.
      inputFilePath - The path to the CSV file, from which the header row is read to determine column mappings.
      Throws:
      NumberFormatException - if a numeric value (e.g., year, longitude, count) is improperly formatted.
      ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException - if the row does not contain enough values.
      IOException - if an error occurs while reading the header row from the file.
